OpenCaller deletes your profile and picture, the spam reports you wrote, and who viewed or searched for you. You\'ll be signed out on every phone. Your blocking rules and settings on this phone stay.
Your profile disappears from caller ID and search at once; everything else is deleted within 30 days. Delete your account now?
Seeing who viewed or searched for you is a supporter feature. Supporter plans arrive in a later update.
These people asked for your name. If you share it, they see it when they search your number. Asking gave you their number and name.
The owner may see that you looked at this profile, unless you turn on Incognito in your profile.
If this number has a private OpenCaller profile, its owner sees your number and name and can share their name with you. You won\'t be told if they say no.
Asked. If they share their name, you\'ll see it when you search this number.
